blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate approved on Wednesday the proposed P915.49 billion budget for the Department of Education (DepEd) and its attached agencies for 2027, including additional funding to expand school feeding. Education Secretary Sonny Angara thanked the Senate leadership, led by Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian, Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente Sotto III, Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri, Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano, and the Senate Committee on Finance for strengthening the basic education budget. Angara also recognized Sen. JV Ejercito, Committee on Finance chair, and Sen. Bam Aquino, Committee on Basic Education chair, for sponsoring the DepEd budget, as well […]...
